tasks.gr12-electric-circuits-internal-resistan: Topic: Electric circuits and internal resistance. Cover emf, internal resistance, terminal potential difference, the relationship ε = V + Ir, series and parallel resistor calculations, current and voltage rules, and power dissipation. Ask Grade 12 learners to explain why terminal voltage changes under load and to solve multistep circuit problems.
tasks.gr12-electrodynamics-generators-motors-t: Topic: Electrodynamics and machines. Cover electromagnetic induction, AC and DC generators, electric motors, slip rings, split-ring commutators, brushes, the motor effect and RMS values. Ask Grade 12 learners to compare machine functions, explain induction and solve simple RMS questions.
tasks.gr12-photoelectric-effect-spectra-t3: Topic: Optical phenomena in modern physics. Cover the photoelectric effect, photons, threshold frequency, work function, the effect of intensity and frequency, and emission and absorption spectra as evidence for quantised energy levels. Ask Grade 12 learners to explain how these ideas support the particle nature of light.
tasks.gr12-electrochemical-reactions-t3: Topic: Electrochemical reactions. Cover galvanic cells, electrolytic cells, oxidation and reduction, anode and cathode, salt bridges, cell notation, standard reduction potential reasoning, electroplating and copper refining. Ask Grade 12 learners to label cells, explain electron flow and apply electrochemistry in industry.
tasks.gr12-fertiliser-industry-t3: Topic: The fertiliser industry. Cover N, P and K and the NPK ratio label with percentage, the Haber, Ostwald and contact processes with balanced equations and catalysts, percentage nitrogen in fertilisers and the environmental impact (eutrophication). Ask Grade 12 learners to balance equations, calculate masses and percentages, and explain conditions.
